questions.text: In basketball, how many points is a successful free throw worth?
questions.explanation: Each successful free throw scores a single point.

questions.text: In which sport would you score with a slam dunk?
questions.explanation: A slam dunk is a shot forced down through the hoop in basketball.

questions.text: What colour card does a soccer referee show to send a player off?
questions.explanation: A red card means immediate dismissal.

questions.text: Which New York baseball team is nicknamed the Bronx Bombers?
questions.explanation: The Yankees play in the Bronx.

questions.text: Which country won the 1966 FIFA World Cup?
questions.explanation: England beat West Germany 4-2 at Wembley.

questions.text: Which baseball legend was nicknamed the Sultan of Swat?
Which Brazilian won the World Cup in 1958 at age 17?
questions.explanation: Pele scored twice in the 1958 final.

questions.text: Which player set a record with a 56-game hitting streak in 1941?
questions.explanation: DiMaggio's streak remains the longest in MLB history.

questions.text: Which player scored the Hand of God goal at the 1986 World Cup?
questions.explanation: Maradona scored it against England in the quarter-final.

questions.text: Who broke baseball's colour barrier in the major leagues in 1947?
questions.explanation: Robinson debuted for the Brooklyn Dodgers on 15 April 1947.

questions.text: Which club won the first European Cup in 1956?
questions.explanation: Real Madrid beat Reims in Paris and won the first five editions.

questions.text: Which pitcher threw a perfect game in the 1956 World Series?
questions.explanation: Larsen's perfect game for the Yankees remains the only one in a World Series.

questions.text: Which Dutch star led the Total Football side at the 1974 World Cup?
questions.explanation: Cruyff captained the Netherlands to the 1974 final.

questions.text: Who scored a hat-trick in the 1966 World Cup final?
questions.explanation: Hurst scored three of England's four goals in the 4-2 win after extra time.

questions.text: In which year did the Boston Red Sox end the Curse of the Bambino by winning the World Series?

spares.text: In soccer, which body part may outfield players not use to play the ball?
spares.explanation: Handling the ball is a foul for outfield players.

spares.text: Pele spent most of his club career at which Brazilian club?
spares.explanation: Pele played for Santos from 1956 to 1974.

spares.text: Which country won the 1992 European Championship after replacing Yugoslavia at short notice?
spares.explanation: Denmark beat Germany 2-0 in the final.
